      "exact_span": "Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date",

      "computation_change_reason": "Sets a phased compliance deadline keyed to permit effective date; different interpretations of that date or whether FY2025 falls before or after the deadline could change whether cyanide limits are enforceable and whether interim progress-reporting obligations remain active."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 6, section part_i",

      "affected_purpose": "B",
      "computation_change_reason": "Imposes recurring quarterly progress-reporting obligations conditioned on not yet having achieved cyanide compliance; interpreting 'until compliance is achieved' differently could change whether reporting was required during specific FY2025 months."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 6, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "No later than 14 calendar days following the date for compliance for Cyanide effluent limitations, the permittee shall submit a written notice of compliance or noncompliance.",
      "affected_purpose": "B",
      "computation_change_reason": "Creates a time-bound reporting obligation tied to the cyanide compliance date; interpreting the trigger date or whether the notice was due during FY2025 could change evaluated monitoring/reporting requirements."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",

      "exact_span": "Complete constructions and cease discharging                 November 2024",
